answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 54714 Country: India Title: UMRAH Question: One of my relatives aged about 60 years went for nafl umrah during this Ramadan. While doing tawaf for umrah she felt uneasiness and weakness, as far as she remembers she completed the seven rounds after that she could not do Sa’i. She was taken to her room by her son. After two three days she went masjid Ayesha and with a fresh ihram she did the umrah. Kindly tell me regarding the first umrah which she could not complete. Will there be some dam etc? Answer ID: 54714 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2008/1721/B=01/1436) If she committed any act against ihram during these two or three days then her umrah was null due to missing Sa’i. One dam (slaughtering an animal) is wajib on her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
